adjudication.rationale: In `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6`, the `saveChanges` action only does `this.get('embedding').update({});`. The only added template for this feature (`admin/templates/embedding.hbs`) wires up actions for `addHost` and `deleteHost` but does not reference `saveChanges` anywhere, so it is currently unused/dead code. Additionally, the corresponding Rails `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` just re-renders the serializer without persisting anything, making the call effectively a no-op even if it were invoked.
